outcomes.name: Sleep quality
outcomes.sentence: One 4-week RCT of 250 mg bisglycinate showed a small sleep-score improvement vs placebo; magnesium trials overall are mixed and low-certainty.

ledger.effect_basis: small d=0.2 on ISI (net 1.6 pts) in matching 155-person RCT; below typical 6-pt MCID

effect.found: Small self-reported sleep improvement in the one exact-form trial.
effect.missing: Objective sleep data, replication, and a clinically meaningful size.
effect.move: A larger, longer RCT with actigraphy.

evidence.found: Schuster 2025 RCT plus older mixed reviews.

form.found: Exact bisglycinate form tested at 250 mg elemental.

dose.found: 250 mg tested is close to 300 mg.

3 RCTs older adults, various forms, SOL -17 min, low quality
